english.title: Producer / rep fail to finance costs of WEEE collection / treatment / recovery / disposal - other than private household

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative,]_

failed to finance the costs of the collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal of WEEE from users other than private households arising during a compliance period from EEE placed on the market in the United Kingdom

(C)_[on or after 13th August 2005 by you]_
(D)_[before 13th August 2005 where you were supplying new EEE that was intended to replace the relevant WEEE and was of an equivalent type or was fulfilling the same function as the relevant WEEE]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:

of WEEE from users other than private households
